products.title: Triple Moon Pocket Knife Pendant
products.body_html: Defend your destiny. Honor the fight in you. Meticulously crafted for the battles we wage every day, the Sapphire Triple Moon Knife Pendant is the latest in a long line of defense jewelry. A deceptively delicate triple moon motif disguises a pocket knife that unfolds in an instant — when needed. White sapphire imbues this functional jewelry with wisdom and strength, for the clarity to know when to awaken your inner warrior.

products.title: Mini Triple Moon Necklace
products.body_html:
The waxing, full and waning moons of the Triple Moon represent divine feminine power in all of its aspects - intuition, creativity, wisdom & mystery. It also symbolizes the three life stages of a woman:

- Waxing Crescent Moon (the Maiden): Purity, youth, beginnings, excitement, enchantment, expansion

- Full Moon (the Mother): Fulfillment, potency, compassion, giving, nurturing, protection, power

- Waning Moon (the Crone): Maturity, wisdom, experience, understanding, completion, rebirth
